messages:
mike_support: Hi team — customer on py-sdk 2.0.0 reported massive increase in immediate timeouts and duplicate billing. They say every request times out in ~30ms after upgrade.
lexi_eng: do we have their repro? which client (sync/async)?
mike_support: async client. They upgraded from 1.11.4 -> 2.0.0. Example they sent:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=..., timeout=30)  # used to work
await client.generate(... )
```
lexi_eng: suspicious — in 2.0 we changed timeout unit to seconds->milliseconds for async init by accident in glue layer. So passing 30 becomes 30ms.
raj_sre: that would cause immediate timeouts and then the app retries quickly -> double requests. Could explain duplicate charges.
mike_support: customer attached logs: "timeout after 0.03s" and stack with AsyncIO CancelledError.
jess_devex: ack. Any quick mitigation we can tell them? Pin back to the last 1.x patch?
lexi_eng: yes pin to 1.11.4 restores old behavior. Also a patch branch in progress to interpret integers as seconds when > 1.
ci-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for hotfix branch "fix/async-timeout-unit" — CI passed for unit tests.
raj_sre: in the meantime, tell customers to explicitly set timeout as float with explicit seconds: timeout=30.0 or pass timeout_ms=30000 (we introduced a timeout_ms kwarg in 2.0, but docs were inconsistent).
mike_support: sending repro steps and recommended pin to customer. Any RFC on how this slipped?
lexi_eng: root cause: internal deprecate of old Timeout class, new wrapper normalizes values but misapplied for ints. We'll add compatibility layer and a deprecation warning in 2.0.1.
jess_devex: I'll update migration guide and add note in CHANGELOG and quick snippet:
```py
# If you upgraded to 2.0 and see 0.03s timeouts, either:
# 1) pin: pip install redwood-sdk==1.11.4
# 2) or pass float seconds: AsyncClient(timeout=30.0)
# 3) or use named ms param: AsyncClient(timeout_ms=30000)
```
mike_support: customer reply: "pinning to 1.11.4 fixed it, thanks." Marking resolved but request to publish advisory and notify enterprise customers.
lexi_eng: agreed — will cut 2.0.1 with compatibility fallback and better tests. Also add telemetry to catch timeout value regressions.
raj_sre: file incident ticket for billing reconciliations if any overcharges were observed.
ci-bot: created ticket #INC-4321 for billing review.
mike_support: closing loop with customer, will escalate billing if needed. Thanks all.
